intro_body: There are so many ways to help bring theater and community to the Bay Area and beyond. You can [donate today](https://pyt.secure.nonprofitsoapbox.com/donate), set up [corporate sponsorship](#corporate), or [sponsor a show or a season](/ways-to-support#sponsor).
matching_note:
Many employers match charitable gifts dollar-for-dollar.
Matching Gift and Volunteer Grant information provided by

sponsor_items.title: Center Stage Show Sponsor
sponsor_items.description:
Back a single production, and receive (optional) recognition, tickets*, and benefits for that title.

\*Ticket benefits have a fair market value of $36 per ticket.

sponsor_items.title: Center Stage Season Sponsor
sponsor_items.description:
Support a full season, with recognition across all material, tickets* and benefits.

\*Ticket benefits have a fair market value of $36 per ticket.

sponsor_items.title: Stories on Stage Sponsor
sponsor_items.description:
[Stories on Stage](/stories-on-stage/) (SOS) - adaptations of beloved children’s books, priced so schools and families can afford to attend. Sponsors individual shows or the full season, with benefits including tickets*, recognition, and VIP scheduling.

\*Ticket benefits have a fair market value of $26 per ticket.
